description: A DITA `Type <userinput>` sentence types into the field its `<uicontrol>` labels, by accessible name (ADR 01227). The fixture jobs run with detectSteps off, so dita-type-into-uicontrol.cjs runs the DITA task through the real CLI with detection on, against the 8092 test server, and checks the detected type step and that every step passed.
